'''Texas easy chili''' is a [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]] and [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]] juice based [[Cookbook:Sauce|sauce]] combined with cubed or ground [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]]. [[Cookbook:Chili|Chili]] originated in Texas in the 1800s. There are many variations of chili. This version does not contain [[Cookbook:Bean|beans]].

==Ingredients==
*3 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] chuck roast or ground beef, [[Cookbook:Cube|cubed]] or formed into small meatballs
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Oil|oil]]
*2 cloves of [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
*6 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]] 
*5 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*1 tablespoon dried [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] ground [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
*3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] tomato juice or V8
*3 beef [[Cookbook:Dehydrated Broth|bouillon]] cubes
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:Black Pepper|Black pepper]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:Lime|Lime]] wedges
*[[Cookbook:Sour Cream|Sour cream]]

==Procedure==
#Cut chuck roast into bite-size pieces or form ground beef into small meatballs (1 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] / 25 [[Cookbook:Mm|mm]] in size).
#[[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] beef in cooking oil until outside is browned.
#Add minced garlic and cook for 2 minutes.
#Combine chili powder, flour, oregano and cumin in bowl and mix well. Sprinkle mixture over cooking beef and stir until beef is well coated with spice mixture. Cook for 1 minute.
#Add tomato juice and bullion cubes. Stir for about 15 seconds.
#[[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
#Remove from heat and add salt and black pepper to taste.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

*Cool and refrigerate overnight to develop flavors (if you can wait; if not, enjoy).
*Heat and serve in bowls with 1 tablespoon of lime juice and 1 tablespoon of sour cream added to top.
*Serve with [[Cookbook:Corn Bread|cornbread]] or [[Cookbook:Sourdough Bread|sourdough bread]].
*For a cool treat, spoon a tablespoon of ranch dressing on top of your chili, along with some cheese!
